Internship - Buy-out Fund of Funds (Paris or London)


11-02-2026



Contract type : 6 Months

Location : Paris or London


With €14.0 billion of investor commitments, Access Capital Partners is one of the leading private asset managers in Europe. The Buy-out Fund of funds team at Access is comprised of investments professionals located in Paris, London, Brussels, and Helsinki and invests in both primary commitments (selecting the best performing buy-out funds in Europe) and secondary transactions (LP stakes and GP-leds).


Role:
 

  • We are seeking an Intern to assist our Buy-out Fund of funds investment team. The internship will include the following responsibilities:
  • Supporting due diligence on primary commitments and secondary transactions
  • Preparing investment recommendations
  • Financial modelling
  • Portfolio monitoring
  • Developing and screening the pipeline of opportunities
  • Supporting the team in day-to-day tasks
     


What Access Capital Partners offers:
 

  • Exceptional deal exposure with steep learning curve
  • Active participation in the decision-making process with direct contact with senior members of the team
  • Robust market expertise
  • Diverse and inclusive environment with various nationalities within the team. English used as standard language in the office
  • A full-time position may be possible at the end of the internship



Requirements:
 

  • Graduated (or due to graduate) from a leading university / graduate school
  • Previous internship in one of the following will be beneficial -- private equity, investment banking, transaction services in a leading audit firm
  • Solid understanding of private equity funds and corporate finance
  • Strong quantitative skills
  • Excellent skills in Microsoft Office suite, with advanced skills in Microsoft Excel in particular. Financial modelling skills will be highly valued
  • Professional fluency in English is a must; fluency in other European languages would be an advantage
  • Intellectual rigour, with ability to work efficiently and in an organised manner
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Valid working permit in the European Union (if applying for Paris) or the UK (if applying for London)
